message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to some great picnic-friendly spots around Miami:

| Spot | What Makes It Great | Best Time/Season | Tips |
|------|---------------------|------------------|------|
| **South Pointe Park** (Miami Beach) | Ocean views, grassy lawns, plenty of shade from palm trees, and easy access to restrooms & trash cans. | All year round – especially sunny afternoons after lunch. | Bring sunscreen and a beach towel if you want to lay on the sand nearby. |
| **Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park** (Key Biscayne) | Historic lighthouse, wide sandy beaches, picnic tables near the water, and walking trails along the coast. | Spring–Fall for cooler temperatures; summer evenings are nice too. | Pack a blanket—there aren’t many shaded areas inside the park itself. |
| **Oleta River State Park** (North Miami) | Largest urban park in FL, offers both freshwater kayaking and lush green spaces perfect for picnics. | Late morning to early afternoon during warmer months. | If you’re bringing kids, consider renting kayaks afterward! |
| **Lummus Park** (Ocean Drive) | Urban beachfront vibe, ample seating, close to cafés and shops. Ideal for a relaxed city‑side picnic. | Early evening sunsets are spectacular. | Keep an eye out for street performers—they add extra entertainment but may crowd the space. |
| **Everglades Holiday Park Picnic Area** (Homestead) | Scenic wetlands view, boardwalks, and designated picnic zones. A bit farther away but worth it for nature lovers. | Mid-morning to mid-afternoon; avoid midday heat. | Wear light clothing and bring insect repellent. |

### Quick Checklist Before You Go:
1. **Check Weather:** Miami can get hot and humid—plan your outing for cooler parts of the day if possible.
2. **Pack Essentials:** Sunscreen, hats, reusable water bottles, snacks, napkins, trash bags, and maybe a small first-aid kit.
3. **Respect Local Rules:** Some parks require permits for larger gatherings or special events—double-check before heading over.
4. **Leave No Trace:** Clean up thoroughly so future visitors enjoy the same pristine environment.

Enjoy your picnic adventure in Miami! 🌞🍉
